units.source_text: 且说末摘花有一个侍女，是她的乳母的女儿，叫作侍从。

en.t: Now, Suetsumuhana had a lady-in-waiting, the daughter of her wet nurse, who was called Jijyu.

units.source_text: 近几年来，这侍从始终服侍她，不曾离去。

en.t: For the past several years, this Jijyu had always served her and had never left.

units.source_text: 侍从在此供职期间，常常到一位斋院那里走动。

en.t: While serving there, Jijyu often went back and forth to the residence of a certain Saiin priestess.

units.source_text: 现在这斋院亡故了，侍从失却了一处依靠，甚是伤心。

en.t: Now that this Saiin had passed away, Jijyu had lost a place to rely on and was deeply saddened.

units.source_text: 末摘花的母亲的妹妹，由于家运衰落，嫁给了一个地方官，家里有好几个女儿，珍爱备至，正在找求良好的青年侍女。

en.t: Suetsumuhana's mother's younger sister, because the family fortunes had declined, had married a provincial official; she had several daughters at home, cherished them dearly, and was looking for a good young lady-in-waiting.

units.source_text: 侍从的母亲曾经和这人家往来，侍从觉得这人家比不相识的人家亲近些，便也常去走动。

en.t: Jijyu's mother had once had dealings with that household, and Jijyu felt it was more familiar than a household of strangers, so she too often visited there.

units.source_text: 末摘花则因性情孤僻，一向疏远这姨母，与她不相往来。

en.t: Suetsumuhana, however, because of her reclusive nature, had always kept this aunt at a distance and had no dealings with her.

units.source_text: 姨母便对侍从说些气话：“我姐姐为了我只是个地方官太太，看我不起，说是丢了她的脸。

en.t: The aunt would then say bitter things to Jijyu: "My elder sister looks down on me because I am only the wife of a provincial official, and says I disgrace her.

units.source_text: 现在她的女儿境况穷困，我也无心照顾她。”

en.t: Now her daughter is in poor circumstances, but I have no inclination to look after her either."

units.source_text: 话虽如此说，也常常来信慰问。

en.t: Although she said this, she still often sent letters asking after her and offering comfort.
